exposure: Deep learning algorithm-based B ultrasound scoring system
outcome: Prediction of pernicious placenta previa (PPP) depth/type (severe, implantable, adhesive, penetrating)
Diagnostic performance (positive predictive value, negative predictive value, false positive rate) of the scoring system
cohort: 60 patients with pernicious placenta previa (PPP) classified into low-risk and high-risk groups.
finding: The deep learning algorithm-based B ultrasound diagnostic scoring system effectively predicts the depth of pernicious placenta previa, demonstrating high positive and negative predictive values and specific cut-off points for different accreta types.
